review_scope.basis: Blind visual review of every supplied PNG for desktop, 390px mobile, 320px narrow, reduced-motion, and final interaction states.

purpose_and_hierarchy.evidence: The warning strip is unmistakable, the editorial lead is immediately legible, and the dark decision card gives the caution state and 06:40–08:10 window strong contrast. Time bands, observations, checklist, advisory, and local-demo form follow in a clear task sequence.
purpose_and_hierarchy.weaknesses: On phones, the actual departure decision begins below a tall brand-and-lead block, so the fastest answer is not visible in the initial viewport. On desktop, current observations sit below the hero rather than alongside the primary decision.

visual_system.evidence: A cohesive harbour-derived system combines the cream chart grid, deep teal, amber warnings, waterline/ring motifs, nautical icons, editorial serif headlines, and compact technical labels. Cards, rules, status dots, and rounded geometry are consistently applied without looking generic.
visual_system.weaknesses: The restrained card-based language is highly refined but a little more familiar than the strongest bespoke editorial systems, and some tiny uppercase/supporting labels lose force beside the oversized headlines.

responsive_quality.evidence: All supplied widths remain composed with no visible horizontal overflow. The desktop grid becomes a clean single-column flow; tabs become large full-width touch targets; observations form a readable 2-by-2 grid even at 320px; checklist, advisory, form, and footer reflow deliberately. The reduced-motion rendering remains complete and visually stable.
responsive_quality.weaknesses: The 320px page is necessarily very long, and the top warning wraps to two lines, but neither issue damages comprehension or fit.

polish.evidence: Fine-grained finish is visible in custom icons, checkbox/count treatment, selected-status color changes, helpful advisory copy, explicit local-only form disclosure, focused input treatment, and a clearly styled success result. Spacing, borders, corner radii, and typography remain coherent across every screenshot.
polish.weaknesses: In the final interaction screenshot, the visible skip link overlays and obscures part of the Wind observation, which weakens an otherwise very controlled state. A few secondary notes are quite small for glare-prone outdoor use.

purpose_and_hierarchy.evidence: The warning strip is dominant, and the wide desktop hero pairs the lead directly with a large operational panel containing the selected outlook, departure window, advisory, and all four observations. The numbered sequence from outlook to checklist, advisory, and notices is unusually easy to scan.
purpose_and_hierarchy.weaknesses: On phones, the lead still fills most of the initial viewport before the decision panel appears. Several all-caps micro-labels are small enough to slow scanning in demanding outdoor conditions.

visual_system.evidence: The industrial harbour-board grammar is highly distinctive: modular split panels, chart grid, serialized section labels, stencil/monospace readings, square status marks, angled logo, broad teal fields, and hazard-strip accents all feel derived from the briefing context. The system is consistent across default and hold states.
visual_system.weaknesses: The intentionally austere treatment occasionally becomes severe: fine rules, condensed mono labels, and sparse outlined boxes are less immediately friendly than the primary serif display language.

responsive_quality.evidence: There is no visible overflow at 390px or 320px. The split desktop hero stacks logically, the observation matrix changes from 2-by-2 to a single column at 320px, time bands become full-width rows, and the footer and form collapse cleanly. Reduced-motion preserves the same readable layout.
responsive_quality.weaknesses: At 320px, the large 06:40–08:10 reading breaks across two lines and the observation panel becomes notably tall. The mobile composition relies on many hard-edged full-width bands, producing a heavier, longer reading rhythm than the desktop layout.

polish.evidence: Default and final states are visually complete: the selected 09:00 hold state updates color, reading values, and status copy; the form failure is explicit and preserves the no-send/no-store boundary; focused control styling is visible; and the brand/footer treatment is resolved at every width.
polish.weaknesses: The visible skip link in the final interaction state overlaps the comparison area and partly crowds the first time band. The hazard stripe terminates somewhat abruptly on mobile, several support/error lines are very small, and the checklist lacks the extra completion affordance and feedback visible in A.
